test_registry_load: test the registry.load function to instantiate an MJX environment by name with optional config and overrides
test_registry_get_default_config: test the registry.get_default_config function to retrieve the default ConfigDict for a registered environment
test_dm_control_suite_register_environme: test dm_control_suite.register_environment to register a custom environment class with its default config factory
test_locomotion_register_environment: test locomotion.register_environment to register a custom locomotion environment with its default config factory
test_manipulation_register_environment: test manipulation.register_environment to register a custom manipulation environment with its default config factory
test_registry_all_envs: test that registry.ALL_ENVS contains the sorted union of dm_control_suite, locomotion, and manipulation environment names
test_dm_control_suite_all_envs: test that dm_control_suite.ALL_ENVS is a non-empty tuple of registered environment names
test_locomotion_all_envs: test that locomotion.ALL_ENVS is a non-empty tuple of registered locomotion environment names
test_manipulation_all_envs: test that manipulation.ALL_ENVS is a non-empty tuple of registered manipulation environment names
